verdicts.reason: A has the strongest hierarchy: the bold headline and lime CTA are readable at 320x50. However, the subhead is squeezed into a cramped three-line wrap, the shoe is shrunk to a tiny icon, and the LIMITED badge sits awkwardly stacked over the shoe and the CTA in the right corner. B keeps the original left-to-right order, but it is mostly a shrunk copy of the original: the headline, subhead and LIMITED badge are too small to read, the CTA is undersized and stranded at the far right, and a large dead gap sits in the middle.
